'''Shimholt''' were a tall, [[Color/Legends|purple]]-skinned [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Species/Legends|species]]<ref name="marvel69" /> native to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kar'a'katok]]. A very long-lived race, the Shimholt were known as a friendly, agrarian species until around [[4000 BBY/Legends|4000 BBY]], when Kar'a'katok was devastated by invading [[Nelori Marauders]]. The war turned the Shimholt into a xenophobic and reclusive species, and although their wholehearted embrace of military doctrine repelled the Nelori, it gave rise to a fanatical religious faction that overthrew the planet's democratic government and ruled the Shimholt for millennia. Kar'a'katok was deemed closed to outsiders and Shimholt forbidden to travel offworld&mdash;no Shimholt were seen in the wider [[The galaxy/Legends|galaxy]] until the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], when a Shimholt named [[Suprema|Ampotem Za]] was taken [[Prison/Legends|prisoner]] during an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] raid on Kar'a'katok. Rendered a pariah on his [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] for being taken offworld, Za submitted to the Empire and served until his death in [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]] under the name "Suprema."<ref name="aliens" />
